shared_or_similar_visual_information: A short stroke crossing a longer line.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It marks the two pieces of chord AD cut by BC as equal in length. Right image: It is a coordinate-axis tick marking a position at which a horizontal coordinate can be read.
Rationales: The matching strokes on the left encode equality of the marked segment lengths. On the right the short stroke lies on a coordinate axis and marks a reading position. Coordinate ticks do not assert that nearby graph segments have equal lengths.
